name: Medium
description: Medium is an online publishing platform where writers and organizations create long-form stories and publications for a reader community. It combines hosted authoring, distribution, subscriptions, recommendations, and publication membership in one service.
agentUseSummary: Medium is unavailable for new Relay connections because Medium does not issue new integration tokens or allow new integrations. Relay mounts no Medium tools and does not accept grandfathered tokens, automate the website, or imply that an unsupported API is available.

blocked.label: Block unsupported API actions
blocked.description: Account access, publication reads, drafts, publishing, uploads, follows, recommendations, responses, and arbitrary historical API calls are unavailable because Medium permits no new integrations.

blocked.label: Block unsupported workarounds
blocked.description: Relay does not automate Medium's website, solicit grandfathered integration tokens, scrape content, or present RSS/import features as authenticated Medium account control.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Medium actions are available without a supported public authorization path for new integrations.

providerSetup.blocker: Medium's current Help Center says it will not issue new integration tokens and will not allow new integrations; the historical API remains only for existing tokens.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Medium unpublished and re-run provider research only if Medium publicly reopens a supported new-integration program or grants Relay a written supported integration contract.

evidence.supports: Medium explicitly states that it issues no new integration tokens and allows no new integrations, while existing tokens continue only for grandfathered users.
Medium's API terms prohibit automatically generated posts not initiated by a Medium user, core-experience replacement, spam, unnecessary caching, and destabilizing usage.
Medium's historical API documentation is archived and does not establish a supported new Relay integration path.
